# KhonsuGraph

> Built for Hunters. Open-source, local-first graph investigation workbench on HawDB, for macOS and Windows. Cypher and PostgreSQL SQL, a graph canvas, path exploration, record-level evidence, graph algorithms, saved investigations, data-source plugins (CSV, AWS, Neo4j) and reviewable .dash dashboards, with a JSON CLI for AI agents. Independent of HawDB. Apache-2.0.

## Overview

- [English](https://khonsugraph.com/index.md)
- [简体中文](https://khonsugraph.com/zh/index.md)

- [Source](https://github.com/JetSquirrel/KhonsuGraph)

## Use cases

- [Attack path analysis](https://khonsugraph.com/use-cases/attack-path-analysis/index.md): Trace attack paths from the internet to instances and IAM roles on your own machine. Open-source graph investigation with path walks and record-level evidence.
- [Blast radius analysis](https://khonsugraph.com/use-cases/sre-dependency-analysis/index.md): Map service dependencies and find the blast radius of a failing service in a local graph. Open-source, with Cypher paths, graph algorithms and dashboards.
- [Neo4j Browser alternative](https://khonsugraph.com/compare/neo4j-browser-alternative/index.md): A free, open-source desktop alternative to Neo4j Browser for investigation: an embedded graph engine, path walks, record-level evidence and an agent CLI.
